patho.caption_source: edit Medical imaging of a 79 year old woman who had a fall 3 weeks previously. Projectional radiography ("X-ray") shows a subtle subcapital radiodense line Labeled CT scan shows the same. The cortex is coherent, which is atypical of a fracture T1-weighted , turbo spin echo , MRI confirms a fracture, as the surrounding bone marrow has low signal from edema. Hansson pins were used for fixation
